## Post text to X (Twitter)

### How it works

1. Runs when you click Execute Workflow.
2. Publishes a post to X (Twitter) via the SocialRobot API.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node and connect your SocialRobot API credential (API key: socialrobot.io, Scheduler -> API Keys).
- [ ] Select your X (Twitter) account in the Publish to X (Twitter) node.
- [ ] Replace the example caption in the Publish to X (Twitter) node with your own text.

### Customization

Replace the example content, then run the workflow whenever you want to post. Run it any time to post, or connect a Schedule Trigger to automate it. Everything runs inside your own n8n workspace, so you can change any step after import.

## Publish to X (Twitter)

Publishes the content to X (Twitter).

parameters.caption: Automation is not about doing less. It is about doing the boring parts automatically so you can focus on the work that matters.
